name: Ilm
hail: Seedling, you are growing well. We are glad to see it.
Hello, Seedling. Are you well? Is your world kind to you?
Gently, from a world of gardens: hello, Seedling. How are you keeping?
close: Be well, Seedling. Tend yourselves kindly.
finding: It may help you to know this: {part}
{part} Let it settle in, like rain into soil.
Something has ripened that you should have: {part}
{part} Use it however it helps you grow.
sighting: Something you may want to know about: {part}
{part} We thought of you, and wanted you to know.
{part} Please, take good care of yourselves.
archive: From what our gardens have kept: {part}
{part} Plant it where it can do some good.
{part} It grew with us. May it grow with you.
culture: We were gardeners long before we built cities. {part}
{part} We are a patient people. We hope you are too.
About us, since you might wonder: {part}
{part} A garden teaches slowly, and we were slow students.
request: If it would not trouble you: {part}
{part} Only if it does you no harm to share.
So we may know you a little better: {part}
verdict: We have thought about it gently, and long: {part}
{part} We chose with care, for your sake.
{part} Whatever grows from this, may it grow well.
accord: Like two gardens sharing one wall: {part}
{part} May it be good for both our worlds.
Between the Seedling and us, gently: {part}
{part} Let it grow, or let it rest, as it must.
